NVDA.text: Nvidia fell 1.0% as semiconductors lagged Friday's broader market rebound ahead of its Aug. 26 earnings, with elevated yields and AI-spending concerns still pressuring chip shares; no fresh Nvidia-specific catalyst was confirmed.

AVGO.text: Broadcom rose 1.2%, outperforming a semiconductor group that remained soft on Friday; no fresh Broadcom-specific catalyst was confirmed, so the move appears to be a relative rebound within a broader market recovery.

TSM.text: TSM gained 0.7% with Friday's broader market rebound even as semiconductor shares remained mixed; no fresh TSM-specific catalyst was confirmed.

ASML.text: ASML rose 0.8% as U.S. equities rebounded Friday despite continued volatility in chip shares and bond yields; no fresh ASML-specific catalyst was confirmed.

KLAC.text: KLA fell 1.0% for a fourth straight decline, underperforming a rising market while semiconductor peers were mixed; no fresh KLA-specific catalyst was confirmed.

INTC.text: Intel fell 2.2% and underperformed both the broader market and most chip peers; no fresh Intel-specific catalyst was verified, so the move appears to reflect continued semiconductor pressure plus stock-specific weakness without a confirmed news trigger.

MU.text: Micron fell 0.8% in line with a still-soft memory and semiconductor tape after a volatile week; no fresh Micron-specific catalyst was confirmed Friday.

TSLA.text: Tesla jumped 5.1% after Nevada regulators cleared the company to deploy up to 5,000 robotaxis in Clark County, materially advancing its planned Las Vegas robotaxi rollout.

META.text: Meta gained 0.7% with Friday's rebound in large-cap technology shares; no fresh Meta-specific catalyst was confirmed.

PLTR.text: Palantir rose 3.4% as growth and software stocks rebounded, extending momentum from its strong Aug. 4 earnings; no fresh company-specific catalyst was confirmed Friday.

SPCX.text: SpaceX rebounded 2.2%, snapping a three-day losing streak as the broader market recovered; no fresh Friday catalyst was confirmed after Thursday's lockup-supply and Starship-timeline pressure.
